title: Identify the full names and email addresses of members who are not regular
question: Identify the full names and email addresses of members who are not regular 'Member' (i.e., hold leadership roles), come from Illinois, and have either incurred an expense over $50 between September and November 2019 OR received income of exactly $50 during the same period.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT T1."XCL_035", T1."XCL_036", T1."XCL_037"
FROM member AS T1
JOIN zip_code AS T4 ON T1."XCL_041" = T4."XCL_043"
WHERE T1."XCL_038" != 'Member'
  AND T4."XCL_047" = 'Illinois'
  AND (
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM expense AS T2
      WHERE T2."XCL_022" = T1."XCL_034"
        AND T2."XCL_020" > 50
        AND T2."XCL_019" BETWEEN '2019-09-01' AND '2019-11-30'
    )
    OR
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM income AS T3
      WHERE T3."XCL_029" = T1."XCL_034"
        AND T3."XCL_026" = 50
        AND T3."XCL_025" BETWEEN '2019-09-01' AND '2019-11-30'
    )
  )
